findings.plain: Clean result: no obstruction, no free gas
Clean result: no problem at the right iliac fossa
Inflamed appendix with a pus collection
A tumour of the caecum that can mimic appendicitis in an older patient
Inflamed outpouching of the colon that can mimic appendicitis
Fluid in the lungs (fluid overload, heart failure)
Partly collapsed lung (for example after pain or surgery)
Irregularly irregular rhythm, no clear P waves
Slow ventricular rate, atria and ventricles out of step
Inflamed appendix on MRI (for example in pregnancy)
Dilated duct with a filling defect
We still don't know — this is NOT the same as negative
